from common import *
import pandas as pd,numpy as np,joblib
from scipy.optimize import linear_sum_assignment

from backtest.scripts.prepare.restore_weekly_h5_quotes import restore
FACTORS=['small_big','lowvol_highvol','momentum'];COLS=['mkt','mkt_vol',*FACTORS]
def split(f,c):
 h=20
 cal=pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(CAL.read_text().splitlines()))
 allmonths=pd.Series(cal,index=cal).groupby(cal.to_period('M'))
 full=[month for month,days in allmonths if days.isin(f.index).all()]
 f=f.loc[f.index.to_period('M').isin(full)]
 ix=f.index;key=ix.to_period('M').factorize()[0];last=len(ix)
 assert len(full)==len(set(key)) and all(ix[key==i].equals(pd.DatetimeIndex(allmonths.get_group(month))) for i,month in enumerate(full))
 d=pd.read_parquet(OLD/'data/daily-market.parquet').loc[ix]
 ref=read(FW/'stages/weekly-h5/docs/label-fit.json'); legacy=read(OLD/'docs/label-audit.json')
 # Every retained calendar month has all provider trading sessions.
 x=f.loc[ix,[s+f'_h{h}' for s in FACTORS]].groupby(key[:last]).mean().set_axis(FACTORS,axis=1)
 x['mkt']=d.mkt.iloc[:last].groupby(key[:last]).sum();x['mkt_vol']=d.mkt.iloc[:last].groupby(key[:last]).std();x=x[COLS]
 bounds=pd.DataFrame({'day':ix,'ready':f.loc[ix,'exit_h'+str(h)].values}).groupby(key[:last]).agg(first=('day','first'),last=('day','last'),ready=('ready','max'))
 train=bounds.ready.le(CUT);assert train.sum()>100
 job='cluster-'+c
 event('fit_start',exp_id=EID,job_id=job,seed=42,label_horizon=h,command=[sys.executable,__file__,c])
 with threadpool_limits(limits=1):
  scale=StandardScaler().fit(x[train]);model=KMeans(n_clusters=4,n_init=100,random_state=42).fit(scale.transform(x[train]));raw=model.predict(scale.transform(x))
 cost=((model.cluster_centers_[:,None]-np.array(ref['reference_centers_standardized'])[None])**2).sum(axis=2)
 i,j=linear_sum_assignment(cost);names={int(a):legacy['mapping'][str(b)] for a,b in zip(i,j)}
 bounds['cluster']=raw;bounds['style4']=[names[int(a)] for a in raw];bounds['style']=np.where(bounds.style4=='T','T','N');bounds['fit']=train
 periods=bounds.join(x);periods.to_csv(BASE/'data'/f'{c}-periods.csv',index_label='block')
 dates=bounds.iloc[key[:last]].copy();dates.index=ix;dates.index.name='datetime';dates['block']=key[:last];dates.to_parquet(BASE/'data'/f'{c}-dates.parquet')
 path=BASE/'data'/f'{c}-clusters.joblib';joblib.dump({'scaler':scale,'model':model,'mapping':names,'columns':COLS},path)
 r=BASE/'docs'/f'{job}.json';save(r,dict(stage=c,complete_blocks=len(x),fit_blocks=int(train.sum()),counts=bounds.groupby(['fit','style']).size().rename('n').reset_index().to_dict('records'),model=fp(path),mapping=names,centers_by_style={names[i]:dict(zip(COLS,map(float,v))) for i,v in enumerate(scale.inverse_transform(model.cluster_centers_))},first=str(ix[0].date()),last=str(ix[-1].date()),periods=fp(BASE/'data'/f'{c}-periods.csv'),dates=fp(BASE/'data'/f'{c}-dates.parquet')))
 event('fit_result',job_id=job,outcome='succeeded',evidence=[str(r),str(path)]);print('labelled',c,len(periods),flush=True)
if __name__=='__main__':
 note_src(__file__);f=pd.read_parquet(verify(read(REF/"docs/spreads.json")["spread_file"]))
 for c in CANDS:split(f,c)

from common import *

def partition(key,h,y,training):
 dts=y.index.get_level_values('datetime');cal=pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(CAL.read_text().splitlines()))
 if key=='all20' and training:return y
 if training:
  dt=cal[cal.get_loc(CUT)-h-1];y=y.loc[dts<=dt];dts=y.index.get_level_values('datetime')
 if key.startswith('all'):return y
 c,style=key.split('-');dates=pd.read_parquet(BASE/'data'/f'{c}-dates.parquet')
 keep=dates.index[(dates['style']==style)&(dates['ready']<=pd.Timestamp(CUT if training else END))]
 return y[dts.isin(keep)]
def assemble(key,h,training):
 mode='train' if training else 'valid'
 ys=pd.read_pickle(verify(read(BASE/'docs/targets.json')['H'+str(h)])) if training else pd.read_pickle(TMP/f'valid-grade-{h}.pkl')
 y=partition(key,h,ys.squeeze().dropna().sort_index(),training);assert y.index.is_unique and y.groupby(level='datetime').size().min()>=20
 del ys;gc.collect()
 dts=y.index.get_level_values('datetime');years=dts.year.to_numpy();fm=read(FM)['blocks'];arr=np.lib.format.open_memmap(TMP/f'{mode}-matrix.npy',mode='w+',dtype='float32',shape=(len(y),164))
 columns=read(PG/'docs/inference-input-2020.json')['features']['columns']
 for yr in np.unique(years):
  if training:
   b=fm[str(yr)];p=verify(b,FM.parent)
  else:p=verify(read(BASE/'docs'/f'formal-{yr}.json')['input'])
  frame=pd.read_pickle(p);mask=years==yr;ix=y.index[mask];lookup=frame.index.get_indexer(ix);assert lookup.min()>=0,(key,mode,yr,(lookup<0).sum())
  assert list(frame.columns)==columns,(mode,yr,list(frame.columns)[:3])
  subset=frame.iloc[lookup].to_numpy(dtype=np.float32,copy=False);ii=np.flatnonzero(mask);arr[ii[0]:ii[-1]+1]=subset
  del frame,lookup,subset;gc.collect()
 arr.flush();del arr
 return y
class Daily:
 def __init__(self,y):
  self.y=y.to_numpy(); self.index=y.index
  dates=y.index.get_level_values('datetime').to_numpy();self.bounds=np.r_[0,np.flatnonzero(dates[1:]!=dates[:-1])+1,len(y)]
  self.ranks=[];self.trace=[]
  for a,b in zip(self.bounds[:-1],self.bounds[1:]):
   t=rankdata(self.y[a:b]);t-=t.mean();norm=np.sqrt(np.dot(t,t));assert norm>0 and b-a>=20
   self.ranks.append(t/norm)
 def evaluate(self,pred,data):
  assert len(pred)==len(self.y)
  values=[]
  for a,b,t in zip(self.bounds[:-1],self.bounds[1:],self.ranks):
   r=rankdata(pred[a:b]);r-=r.mean();norm=np.sqrt(np.dot(r,r))
   if norm:values.append(np.dot(r,t)/norm)
  if not values:raise ValueError('No nonconstant prediction days')
  score=float(np.mean(values))
  if not self.trace:
   # Independent reference including average-tie behavior; same-day index and true ordinal grades.
   assert np.array_equal(data.get_label(),self.y) and np.array_equal(np.unique(self.y),np.arange(10))
   limit=min(8,len(self.ranks));b=int(self.bounds[limit])
   if len(values)==len(self.ranks):
    direct=models.mean_daily_rank_ic(pred[:b],self.y[:b],self.index[:b])
    assert abs(np.mean(values[:limit])-direct)<1e-12
  self.trace.append({'round':len(self.trace)+1,'rankic':score,'finite_days':len(values),'constant_days':len(self.ranks)-len(values)})
  return 'daily_rank_ic',score,True
def main(key):
 h=20 if key=='all20' or key.endswith('-T') else 7
 rs=BASE/'docs';pending=[s for s in SEEDS if not (rs/f'{key}-s{s}.json').exists()]
 if not pending:return

 assert np.array_equal(np.unique(g.to_numpy()),np.arange(10)) and len(np.unique(y.to_numpy()))==10
 X=np.load(TMP/'train-matrix.npy',mmap_mode='r');V=np.load(TMP/'valid-matrix.npy',mmap_mode='r')
 exp=read(V5/'configs/model-manifest.json')
 if key=='all20':
  ref=read(PG/'docs/quantile10-old-s42-a1-inputs.json')
  def array_sha(v):
   digest=hashlib.sha256()
   for j in range(0,len(v),8192):digest.update(v[j:j+8192].tobytes(order='C'))
   return digest.hexdigest()
  evidence={k:array_sha(v) for k,v in [('feature_array_sha256',X),('label_values_sha256',y.to_numpy()),('weights_sha256',wt)]}
  assert all(ref[k]==v for k,v in evidence.items()),(evidence,{k:ref[k] for k in evidence})
  save(rs/'all20-v5-input-equivalence.json',dict(**evidence,reference=fp(PG/'docs/quantile10-old-s42-a1-inputs.json'),rows=len(y),statement='All original v5 ordered features, H20 ten-grade training labels and M0 weights are byte-identical.'))
 save(rs/f'{key}-population.json',dict(training_rows=len(y),valid_rows=len(g),training_days=y.index.get_level_values(0).nunique(),valid_days=g.index.get_level_values(0).nunique(),training_min=str(y.index[0][0].date()),training_max=str(y.index[-1][0].date()),validation_min=str(g.index[0][0].date()),validation_max=str(g.index[-1][0].date()),valid_grade_counts=np.bincount(g.to_numpy()).tolist(),train_target=read(rs/'targets.json')['H'+str(h)],early_stop='cross-sectional Spearman against actual 10 grade labels, equally weighted daily mean',data_scope=key))
 for seed in pending:
  jid=f'stock-{key}-{seed}';attempt=sum(v.get('event',{}).get('job_id','').startswith(jid+'-a') and v.get('event',{}).get('type')=='fit_start' for v in read(STATE)['events'])+1
  job=f'{jid}-a{attempt}';session='tnm26_'+key.lower().replace('-','_')+'_s'+str(seed)
  kw=dict(tr.FROZEN_SINGLE_KWARGS);kw['early_stopping_rounds']=50
  model=models.RegimeSingleLGBMModel(protocol_id='regime-adapt-v1',valid_dates_csv=None,day_weights_csv=str(WEIGHTS),seed=seed,es_metric='daily_rank_ic',**kw)
  params=read(ROOT/next(c['training']['path'] for c in exp['components'] if c['seed']==seed))['parameters'];assert params==model.params
  event('fit_start',exp_id=EID,job_id=job,seed=seed,label_horizon=h,command=[sys.executable,__file__,key,str(seed)]);ts=time.time()
  try:
   dtrain=lgb.Dataset(X,label=y.to_numpy(),weight=wt);dv=lgb.Dataset(V,label=g.to_numpy())
   ranks=Daily(g)
   model.model=lgb.train({**model.params,'objective':'mse','metric':'None'},dtrain,num_boost_round=200,valid_sets=[dv],valid_names=['valid'],feval=ranks.evaluate,callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(50,first_metric_only=True,verbose=False)])
   b=model.model.best_iteration; hist=ranks.trace;assert int(np.argmax([v['rankic'] for v in hist]))+1==b and len(hist)==min(200,b+50)
   es=dict(es_metric='daily_rank_ic',target='H%d_quantile10'%h,scope=key,best_iteration=b,best_score=hist[b-1]['rankic'],valid_days=len(ranks.ranks),metric_history=[v['rankic'] for v in hist],evaluated_iterations=len(hist),num_boost_round=200,early_stopping_rounds=50)
   model.rankic_evals_result=[es];su=dict(arm='m0',model='single',seed=seed,label_horizon=h,label_expr=evexpr(h),es_metric='daily_rank_ic',es_valid_source='eval_window',es_scope=key,label_encoding='quantile10',rankic_evals=[es],fit_seconds=time.time()-ts,training_regime=key,frozen_hyperparams='v5 M0 single LightGBM, weighted MSE, ten-grade RankIC patience 50')
   sd=tr.save_session('m0',seed,session,model,su);m=read(sd/'meta.json');m.update(owner_experiment=EID,provider_uri=str(PROV));save(sd/'meta.json',m)

   event('fit_result',job_id=job,outcome='succeeded',evidence=[str(r),str(path)])
   print('FIT',key,seed,'best',b,'score',es['best_score'],'seconds',round(time.time()-ts),flush=True)
   del model,dtrain,dv,ranks;gc.collect()
  except BaseException:
   r=rs/f'{job}-failed.json';save(r,dict(job=job,traceback=traceback.format_exc()));event('fit_result',job_id=job,outcome='failed',evidence=[str(r)]);raise

import numpy as np,pandas as pd,gc,functools
from backtest.scripts.evaluate import eval_ic_multi_pool as ev
from backtest.scripts.train.train_regime_arm import frame_signature
def grade(y):
 y=y.dropna();groups=y.groupby(level='datetime');r=groups.rank(method='average').to_numpy()*2;n=groups.transform('size').to_numpy()
 out=((10*r.astype('int64')-1)//(2*n)).astype(np.int8);assert out.min()>=0 and out.max()<=9
 return pd.Series(out,index=y.index,name='grade')
def traintargets():
 dates=pd.read_csv(DATES,comment='#',parse_dates=['date']).date
 cal=pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(CAL.read_text().splitlines()))
 src=read(HIST/'docs/prepared-labels.json')['horizons']['7']; oldsrc=read(V5/'configs/model-manifest.json')['label_transform']; old=verify(oldsrc['old']);y20=pd.read_pickle(old).squeeze().sort_index();assert len(y20)==5448963
 parts=[]
 for v in src['blocks']:
  y=pd.read_pickle(verify(v)).squeeze().sort_index();y=y[y.index.get_level_values('datetime').isin(dates)].dropna();parts.append(y)
 y=pd.concat(parts);g=grade(y);dts=y.index.get_level_values('datetime');cut=cal[cal.get_loc(CUT)-8];mask=dts<=cut
 # Affine matched on training-mature H7; no evaluation or own-style inputs.
 scale=float(y[mask].std(ddof=0)/g[mask].std(ddof=0));offset=float(y[mask].mean()-scale*g[mask].mean())
 y7=(scale*g.astype('float64')+offset).astype('float32');assert len(y7.index.unique())==len(y7)
 y7.to_frame('LABEL0').to_pickle(BASE/'data/stock-H7-quantile10.pkl')
 save(BASE/'docs/targets.json',{'H20':fp(old),'H7':fp(BASE/'data/stock-H7-quantile10.pkl'),'H7_source':fp(HIST/'docs/prepared-labels.json'),'H7_scale':scale,'H7_offset':offset,'H7_calibration_rows':int(mask.sum()),'H7_last_mature_train_signal':str(cut.date()),'full_h20_rows':len(y20),'full_h7_rows':len(y7)})
def validation():
 initqlib()
 from qlib.data import D
 cal=pd.DatetimeIndex(D.calendar(start_time=START,end_time=END))
 hs=[5,7,20]; labels=ev.prepare_pool_labels('all',START,END,hs,{h:ev.label_window_cutoff(cal,h) for h in hs},min_listing_days=60,st_daily=PROV.parent/'st_daily.csv',min_amount=1e7)
 trad=ev.entry_tradable_mask('all',START,END);pd.to_pickle({'labels':labels,'tradable':trad},TMP/'labels.pkl')
 # Finite target masks are independent by horizon, never use H5 validity as the universe for H7/H20.

 for h in [7,20]:
  g=grade(labels[h].replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)).sort_index();assert g.index.is_unique and g.groupby(level='datetime').size().min()>=20
  g.to_pickle(TMP/f'valid-grade-{h}.pkl');both[h]={'rows':len(g),'days':g.index.get_level_values('datetime').nunique(),'first':str(g.index[0][0].date()),'last':str(g.index[-1][0].date())}
 save(BASE/'docs/validation-universe.json',{'by_horizon':both,'st_snapshot':fp(PROV.parent/'st_daily.csv'),'label_horizons':hs,'config':fp(BASE/'configs/evaluation.yaml')})

from common import *
import pickle,gc
import numpy as np,pandas as pd

from backtest.scripts.maintenance.config_loader import load_config
def inference(key):
 records=[read(BASE/'docs'/f'{key}-s{s}.json') for s in SEEDS];models=[]
 for r in records:
  with verify(r['model']).open('rb') as f:models.append(pickle.load(f))
 parts=[[] for _ in SEEDS]
 for yr in range(2020,2027):
  frame=pd.read_pickle(verify(read(BASE/'docs'/f'formal-{yr}.json')['input']))
  for i,m in enumerate(models):
   v=m.model.predict(frame.to_numpy(),num_threads=8);assert np.isfinite(v).all()
   parts[i].append(pd.Series(v,index=frame.index,name='score'))
  del frame;gc.collect()
 RESULT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);meta=RESULT/'meta.json'
 if not meta.exists():save(meta,dict(owner_experiment=EID,mode='research_prediction_bundle'))
 scores={};components=[]
 for i,r in enumerate(records):
  out=RESULT/f'{key}-s{r["seed"]}.pkl';score=pd.concat(parts[i]).sort_index();assert score.index.is_unique;score.to_frame().to_pickle(out)
  scores[str(r['seed'])]=score;components.append(dict(seed=r['seed'],session=r['session'],model=r['model'],training=fp(BASE/'docs'/f'{key}-s{r["seed"]}.json'),prediction=fp(out)))
 ref=pd.read_pickle(verify(read(V5/'configs/model-manifest.json')['components'][0]['prediction'])).index
 assert all(s.index.equals(ref) for s in scores.values())
 ens=blend_score_series(list(scores.values()));out=RESULT/f'{key}-ensemble.pkl';ens.to_frame().to_pickle(out);scores['ensemble']=ens
 save(BASE/'docs'/f'predictions-{key}.json',dict(components=components,ensemble=fp(out),full_finite_index=True))
 return scores,components
def quality(key,scores):
 for h in [7,20]:
  label=pd.read_pickle(TMP/f'valid-grade-{h}.pkl')
  cols={}
  for name,score in scores.items():
   d=ev.daily_ic(score,label,min_count=20)
   assert len(d)==label.index.get_level_values('datetime').nunique()
   cols[name]=d['rank_ic'];cols['stocks']=d['count']
  daily=pd.DataFrame(cols)
  daily.to_csv(BASE/'data'/f'{key}-h{h}-daily-rankic.csv',index_label='datetime')
  if key!='v5old' and h==(20 if key=='all20' or key.endswith('-T') else 7):
   selected=daily
   if not key.startswith('all'):
    candidate,style=key.split('-');mapping=pd.read_parquet(BASE/'data'/f'{candidate}-dates.parquet')
    applicable=mapping.index[mapping['style'].eq(style)&mapping['ready'].le(END)]
    selected=daily.loc[daily.index.intersection(applicable)]
   audit=[]
   for seed in SEEDS:
    record=read(BASE/'docs'/f'{key}-s{seed}.json');stop=record['early_stopping'];v=selected[str(seed)].dropna()
    assert len(v)==record['rounds'][stop['best_iteration']-1]['finite_days']
    delta=abs(float(v.mean())-stop['best_score'])
    audit.append(dict(seed=seed,best_round=stop['best_iteration'],days=len(v),recomputed=float(v.mean()),early_stop=stop['best_score'],absolute_error=delta))
   save(BASE/'docs'/f'replayed-early-stop-{key}.json',dict(scope=key,horizon=h,source='Full saved-model predictions scored with eval_ic_multi_pool.daily_ic and actual decile labels on the same days.',seeds=audit))

 if key=='v5old':
  v=read(V5/'configs/model-manifest.json');scores={str(r['seed']):pd.read_pickle(verify(r['prediction'])).squeeze() for r in v['components']};scores['ensemble']=pd.read_pickle(verify(v['ensemble'])).squeeze();quality(key,scores);return
 scores,components=inference(key);quality(key,scores)
 initqlib();cache=pd.read_pickle(TMP/'labels.pkl');cfg=load_config(str(BASE/'configs/evaluation.yaml'))
 class Frozen:
  def __init__(self,s):self.s=s
  def predict(self,*args,**kwargs):return self.s
 sessions=[(r['session'],r['seed']) for r in components];pmap={session:scores[str(seed)] for session,seed in sessions}
 ev._build_dataset=lambda *a,**kw:None;ev._load_model=lambda k:Frozen(pmap[k]);ev.prepare_pool_labels=lambda *a,**kw:{5:cache['labels'][5]};ev.entry_tradable_mask=lambda *a,**kw:cache['tradable']
 regime=ev.load_regime_monthly(next(E.glob('strategies/topk-dropout/v2-top5-hold-f100/variants/bt-v5/configs/monthly_regime_labels_eval_window_v1.csv'))) if key.startswith('all') else None
 result=ev.evaluate_multi_horizon(cfg,sessions,['all'],horizons=[5],head_k=[3],exclude_limit_up=True,min_listing_days=60,min_amount=1e7,st_daily=PROV.parent/'st_daily.csv',regime_monthly=regime)
 assert result['pools']['all']['ensemble']['head']['3']['5']['n_days']==1448
 save(BASE/'metrics'/f'official-{key}.json',result)
